# Requirements Checklist: opening a service starts its entry blocks shut

**Spec**: `specs/204-dock-entry-open-reset/spec.md` · **Created**: 2026-11-19 · **Depth**: Standard

*Generated by the agent; never ticked by the agent. All 25 items were ticked at **Gate 2,
2026-11-19**, on the owner's word (`accept` to the gate's "tick all 25 and accept" question); the
five analysis findings were reported with it and none was a change request. CHK021–CHK025 were
appended after gate 1, when Plan added the placement, per-path tests, red-first scope, bump and
unchanged-pin questions.*

## Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Is the reset's trigger set enumerated exhaustively — picker row click, `Enter` on the
  marked picker row, the on-load resume of the service on air — and the non-triggers named in the
  same breath (`update` message, 10 s timer, crossing, reload)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003/US2]
- [x] CHK002 Does the spec cover *every* block in the opened service, not only the leaked position:
  several hand-opened blocks, and positions the new list does not have? [Completeness, Spec
  §US1-AC3/SC-003]
- [x] CHK003 Is the live-entry exception defined by a fact the dock can read at paint time (the
  display state's service and screen) rather than by an index carried from the previous list?
  [Completeness, Spec §Key Entities/FR-002/A3]
- [x] CHK004 Are the subjects that carry no entry block named — section break, empty service, the
  go to's own block — so the reset has no undefined case? [Completeness, Spec §Edge Cases/A5]
- [x] CHK005 Does the spec state which existing requirement it modifies and which it leaves
  standing, by capability and `R<n>`? [Completeness, Spec §Requirements]

## Clarity

- [x] CHK006 Is an *open* distinguished from a *re-read* and from a *crossing* in one place a
  reader can apply without opening the code? [Clarity, Spec §Key Entities/FR-003]
- [x] CHK007 Is "reset" defined as discarding overrides so the base rule paints shut, rather than
  as an action that closes blocks — which would imply a collapse animation? [Clarity, Spec
  §FR-001/FR-005/US3]
- [x] CHK008 Is the request's word "entry" resolved to a concrete surface, with that reading
  recorded as an assumption the owner can veto at the gate? [Clarity, Spec §A2/Clarifications]
- [x] CHK009 Does "silent" enumerate what must not happen — morph, glide, scroll, centring, display
  write, broadcast — instead of resting on an adjective? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005/US3-AC1/AC2]

## Consistency

- [x] CHK010 Does any line of the pack contradict spec 198's crossing rule (`dock/R14`) or spec
  195's re-read rule (`dock/R13`)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004/US2/SC-005]
- [x] CHK011 Is the live entry's treatment the same in FR-002, US1-AC4/AC5, SC-004 and the UI/UX
  state list — open block, no chevron, selected tint, `aria-current`? [Consistency, Spec
  §FR-002/US1/SC-004/UI/UX]
- [x] CHK012 Does the unanswered question's assumption (A1) agree with every requirement that
  depends on it, and are the two readings it would supersede named rather than dropped?
  [Consistency, Spec §A1/Clarifications]
- [x] CHK013 Are the cited capability requirements the ones `docs/spec/dock.md` actually holds
  (R14, R13, R11, R3), with no invented `R<n>`? [Consistency, Spec §Requirements]

## Measurability

- [x] CHK014 Does every success criterion name a count, a height or a byte comparison a probe can
  read back from the DOM, rather than "works as expected"? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001…SC-007]
- [x] CHK015 Are the UI/UX numbers measured on the running preview and attributed to a file, not
  adjectives or remembered values? [Measurability, Spec §UI/UX]
- [x] CHK016 Is the "no motion" claim falsifiable — a class scan for `is-morph` and a scroll sample
  across the open — rather than a look at a screenshot? [Measurability, Spec §US3-AC1/SC-006]

## Coverage

- [x] CHK017 Does every FR and SC reach a story scenario, and does every scenario have a
  requirement behind it? [Coverage, Spec §User Scenarios/Requirements/Success Criteria]
- [x] CHK018 Are all the states the preview exposes listed in UI/UX — rest after an open,
  hand-expanded, live, empty service, section break, reduced motion, narrow, light? [Coverage,
  Spec §UI/UX]
- [x] CHK019 Is the verification method for each requirement declared, or is that left to Plan's

- [x] CHK020 Does the pack name the E2E pins that must change and the ones that must stay green,
